newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London dip in moribund trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London dip in moribund trade.

text.p: Hong Kong shares were marginally lower in thin holiday trade following another strong session in Hong Kong overnight, dealers said.
"The market is absolutely dead. People are still on holiday," one dealer said.
The Hang Seng London Reference index was down 11.43 points at 13,392.71 by 1045 GMT.
In Hong Kong on Friday, the Hang Seng index closed 62.53 points higher at 13,404.14, buoyed by the outlook for the local property market and postive trends on Wall Street, dealers said.
